PYTHON_VERSION.description: Version of Python demanded. Can be a specific numeric version number or an alias

PYTHON_VENV.description: Path to a Python virtualenv (will create if nonexistent)

PYTHON_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install PYTHON. 'libscript_native' uses isolated version dirs, 'system' uses OS package manager, 'mise', 'asdf', 'pkgx', or 'vfox' defers to third-party tools.
